findings: The frozen candidate is novel at this ideation gate: its essential ability is bimanual coaxial stabilization of a straight mandrel during hammer-driven HELICOIL tang fracture, followed by physical recovery of four free fragments while retaining the coils and avoiding shell damage—not a cosmetic variation of an existing task.

Industrial grounding is adequate. ODRI’s pinned shell-preparation procedure requires four M2.5 × 3.75 mm HELICOIL inserts, tang removal, and ensuring tangs do not remain in the part (https://github.com/open-dynamic-robot-initiative/open_robot_actuator_hardware/blob/66af1522b4fba0ec4a1d7790e66f5e4652208d30/mechanics/actuator_module_v1/details/details_shell_preparation.md). Böllhoff documents notch break-off and the M2.5 straight mandrel 0158 040 1000 (https://media.boellhoff.com/files/pdf1/0100-helicoil-plus-en.pdf).

All 2,130 catalog records were compared against the same candidate digest. The strongest neighbors remain materially distinct: pr-1205 automatic center punching, pr-142/pr-143 nail hammering, pr-1468 blind-rivet setting and stem disposal, pr-921 scored-PCB depaneling, pr-1121/pr-1497 tile fracture, and pr-1491 slide-hammer extraction. Their objectives, force paths, and success conditions do not combine precision indirect notch fracture, retained-insert protection, and four-fragment recovery.

The five requested records—pr-1774, pr-1945, pr-1979, pr-1983, and pr-1987—were read completely, have no specs, and are closed, unmerged, other-team, non-board-required records. Their camera-screen folding, battery-clamp reconnection, glad-hand coupling, filter-cake scraping, and cabin-filter replacement objectives do not overlap the selected mechanism.

All 17 unresolved catalog records are correctly retained as uncertain and are nonblocking only because artifacts/novelty.json records each as closed, unmerged, other-team, and non-board-required; this scope matches input/catalog.json. None is represented as proven distinct.

Pinned original-suite coverage is complete and hash-consistent. Closest definitions were LIBERO “put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket,” RoboCasa “CutBuffetPizza” and “PrepForTenderizing,” SimplerEnv “PutEggplantInBasketScene-v0,” BEHAVIOR “chopping_wood-0,” DataCenterBench “Fasten a nut down onto a washer” and “Hold something aside while the other hand works,” and RoboDojo “store_tools_in_toolbox.” None tests the candidate’s combined indirect-impact fracture, retained-hardware protection, and post-fracture fragment accounting.

This pass is limited to sourced objective and novelty readiness. The declared prototype fracture parameters and representative fixture still require the later native PhysX component, damage, reset, timestep, containment, robot-demo, scoring, and evaluation gates; no downstream success is inferred.
